title: The Power of Loaded Language
skills: identify emotionally charged language in texts and media
analyze how word choice shapes audience perception
distinguish neutral wording from loaded wording
evaluate how loaded language affects persuasion, bias, and tone
alignment_note: Examines how loaded language uses emotionally charged words and connotations to influence audience perception and response. Supports rhetorical analysis, argument evaluation, media literacy, bias detection, and intentional word choice across high school English courses.
